rows: Reformed Pension Sector for Many Employees

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The reforms were formulated based on the recommendations of the OASIS (Old Age Social and Income Security) Report.
The primary goal was to bring comprehensive structural reforms to India’s pension sector.
The shift moved India from a traditional defined benefit pension system to a defined contribution system for many employees.
OASIS stands for Old Age Social and Income Security Report—frequently asked in general awareness sections.
Remember the nature of the structural shift: India moved FROM a Defined Benefit system TO a Defined Contribution system.
